decisions.rationale: 教則2.1.2 explicitly requires preflight designation of the intended pilot when multiple skill-certificate holders are present. Q089 and Q188 concern assistant coordination/roles, not pilot responsibility designation.

教則2.2.5 explicitly requires confirming mobile-call coverage and maintaining a communications arrangement with relevant authorities. Q116 concerns airborne cellular-system use, not the operator's ground communications arrangement.

教則2.2.6 explicitly defines clothing characteristics and PPE preparation. No canonical question tests operator clothing/PPE. The proposition is concrete, safety-relevant and independently answer-defining.

教則2.2.1 explicitly says a flight plan is still required for nearby or previously flown locations. Existing planning questions test hazards/changes, not the familiarity-does-not-remove-planning boundary.

教則2.2 flight-in-progress guidance explicitly requires return or emergency landing when deterioration is anticipated, before conditions become dangerous. Existing weather/TEM items cover observation or Threat recognition rather than this action threshold.

The Version 5 insurance expansion explicitly requires sufficient third-party liability coverage for specified Category II operations including 25kg+ or Level 3.5. Existing Q176/Q177 test insurance type/cargo scope, not this required-coverage condition.

教則5.2.3 explicitly says emergency handling must not assume return to takeoff point and should promptly land at a nearby safe uninhabited area. Q044 is preflight emergency-site planning; Q179 concerns GNSS-independent control.

教則5.2.3(1) explicitly defines a second trigger while failsafe is active: insufficient battery/anticipated inability to continue causes transition to landing. Q065/Q139 test radio-link-loss failsafe behavior before this new energy constraint, so the reasoning boundary is distinct.
